dbe_source.recommendation: When you reduce sin(180 + x) or sin(180 - x), the sign depends on the quadrant. sin(180 + x) is in Q3, where sine is negative. So sin(180 + x) = -sin x.

lesson.concept: When you reduce sin(180 + x) or sin(180 - x), the sign depends on the quadrant. sin(180 + x) is in Q3, where sine is negative. So sin(180 + x) = -sin x.
lesson.why: This is one of the most frequent errors DBE reported for this section.

work: Identify the quadrant: 180 + x is in Q3.

learner_message: The magnitude is right, but the sign is off. Check which quadrant the reduced angle sits in — that sets the sign.
